title: Reading lens
description: A native scrolling note preserves a readable center while compressing peripheral lines.
useCase: Keep neighboring passages in view around a focused reading region.
reducedMotion: The note becomes an ordinary native scrolling text column with no compression or animated scrolling.
limitations: The authored line breaks use a fixed 26 px line height. Adapt the mapping for arbitrary wrapping text.
look: Near-black page with a centred column of cream serif lines that flatten and dim toward the edges, monospace header and counter, and hairline rules.
motion: Native scrolling re-maps every line: the five nearest the centre stay full size, farther lines squash vertically and fade with exponential falloff; the arrow smooth-scrolls six lines.
adapt: The fisheye mapping is `update` in the effect keyed on `lens` and `reduced`: lines with `a <= 2` stay full size, then offset and `scaleY` decay exponentially (rate `0.32`). Replace the pre-broken `lines`, which assume a fixed `26` px line height.
